title: Gualou xiebai decoction ameliorates cardiorenal syndrome type II by regulation of PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signalling pathway.
authors: Wang, Ying-Yu; Liu, Yang-Yang; Li, Jie; Zhang, Yun-Yun; Ding, Yong-Fang; Peng, Yun-Ru
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药瓜蒌薤白汤通过PI3K/AKT/NF-κB通路改善心肾综合征，仅涉及信号通路蛋白表达，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cardiorenal syndromes type II (CRS2) is a multi-organ ailment that manifests as a combination of cardiac and renal dysfunction, resulting in chronic kidney disease due to chronic cardiac insufficiency. It affects at least 26 million people worldwide, and its prevalence is increasing. Gualou Xiebai Decoction (GXD), a traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) with a rich history of application in the management of coronary artery disease, has been explored for its potential therapeutic benefits in CRS2. Nevertheless, the mechanism by which GXD alleviates CRS2 remains obscure, necessitating further investigation. PURPOSE: The aim of this study was to assess the effects of the ethanolic extract of GXD on CRS2 and to elucidate the underlying mechanism in a rat model of myocardial infarction, offering a potential target for clinical treatment for CRS2. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: A rat model of CRS2 was induced by surgical myocardial infarction and treated with GXD for 10 weeks. Cardiac function was assessed using echocardiography, while serum and urine biochemistry were analyzed to evaluate potential cardiac and renal damage. Furthermore, tissue samples were obtained for histological, protein, and genetic investigations. In addition, network pharmacology analysis and molecular docking were utilized to predict the primary active compounds, potential therapeutic targets, and interventional pathways through which GXD could potentially exert its effects on CRS2. Subsequently, these predictions were confirmed in vivo and vitro through various analyses. RESULTS: The current investigation employed echocardiography to exhibit the apparent cardiac remodeling following the induction of myocardial infarction. Damage to the heart and kidneys of CRS2 rats was effectively ameliorated by administration of GXD. The outcomes derived from the analyses of HE and Masson staining indicated that the pathological damage to the heart and kidney tissues of rats in the GXD groups was considerably alleviated. Using network pharmacology analysis, AKT1, IL-6, and TNF-alpha were identified as plausible therapeutic targets for the treatment of CRS with GXD. Subsequent functional and pathway enrichment analysis of the underlying targets disclosed that the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway may be involved in the mechanism of GXD in the treatment of CRS2. Immunohistochemical, western blot, RT-PCR and immunofluorescence staining were employed to demonstrate that GXD can regulate the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway in the CRS2 rat model. Ultimately, administration of the PI3K/AKT agonist 740Y-P counteracted the effect of diosmetin, which was one of the potential active components of GXD analysed by compound-target-disease network, on p-PI3K and p-AKT in vitro. CONCLUSIONS: The findings of this study suggest that GXD improves cardiac and renal function in CRS2 rats and that the underlying mechanism involves inhibition of the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：心肾综合征II型（CRS2）是一种多器官疾病，表现为心脏和肾功能障碍的组合，因慢性心脏功能不全导致慢性肾脏疾病。它影响全球至少2600万人，且患病率不断上升。瓜蒌薤白汤（GXD）是一种在冠状动脉疾病管理中具有丰富应用历史的传统中药（TCM），已被探索其在CRS2中的潜在治疗益处。然而，GXD缓解CRS2的机制仍不清楚，需要进一步研究。目的：本研究旨在评估GXD乙醇提取物对CRS2的影响，并在心肌梗死大鼠模型中阐明其潜在机制，为CRS2的临床治疗提供潜在靶点。研究设计和方法：通过手术诱导心肌梗死建立CRS2大鼠模型，并用GXD治疗10周。使用超声心动图评估心脏功能，同时分析血清和尿液生化指标以评估潜在的心脏和肾脏损伤。此外，获取组织样本用于组织学、蛋白质和遗传学研究。另外，利用网络药理学分析和分子对接预测GXD可能对CRS2发挥作用的初级活性化合物、潜在治疗靶点和干预通路。随后，这些预测在体内和体外通过多种分析得到验证。结果：本研究采用超声心动图展示心肌梗死诱导后的明显心脏重塑。GXD给药有效改善了CRS2大鼠的心脏和肾脏损伤。HE和Masson染色分析结果表明，GXD组大鼠心脏和肾脏组织的病理损伤显著减轻。通过网络药理学分析，AKT1、IL-6和TNF-alpha被确定为GXD治疗CRS的潜在治疗靶点。对潜在靶点的功能和通路富集分析揭示，PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB信号通路可能参与GXD治疗CRS2的机制。采用免疫组织化学、western blot、RT-PCR和免疫荧光染色证明GXD可以调节CRS2大鼠模型中的PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB信号通路。最终，给予PI3K/AKT激动剂740Y-P抵消了地奥司明（diosmetin）——通过化合物-靶点-疾病网络分析得到的GXD潜在活性成分之一——对p-PI3K和p-AKT的体外作用。结论：本研究结果表明，GXD改善CRS2大鼠的心脏和肾脏功能，其潜在机制涉及抑制PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB通路。
